Hero_Desc_AshurMagi:
Ashur has resolved to study magic more seriously.
After meeting Great Ashur and learning of another possible future, she began her studies.
To create a future where everyone can be happy, she strives to make the ultimate magical bread.
Album_Wish_AshurMagi: To create the ultimate magical bread that will save the world
Album_AshurMagi1: Whenever Ashur puts on her newly tailored outfit, she has a habit of muttering formulas that sound impossibly difficult. Once, she was so absorbed in this habit that she walked without looking around and struck her head on a streetlamp.
Album_AshurMagi2: Some Sprites ask Ashur whether those clothes make working at the bakery uncomfortable. Ashur coolly replies that they are not her work clothes. In the past, merely hearing the word 'bakery' would have sent her into a frenzy. Something about her has changed.
Album_AshurMagi3: Ashur often shuts herself in her room to focus on research, but she loves discussing magic just as much. Even the smallest question about magic makes her eyes light up as she explains it. Her explanations are so technical that the Sprite who asked sometimes flees in alarm.
Album_AshurMagi4: According to Patra, Ashur bolts straight to Elemental Mountain whenever she has too much on her mind. Every time she goes, lightning supposedly strikes the mountain's summit... Surely it is a coincidence.
Album_AshurMagi5: Once, the lights at Ashur's Heart were still blazing long after closing time. Looking through the window, I saw Ashur continuing to bake and write down recipes. She murmured that she hoped this batch would suit Erpin's taste.
Album_AshurMagi6: Ashur appears to be deeply engaged in researching magical bread infused with mana. Lately, she seems troubled over how to dispose of the prototypes filling the entire storeroom.
Album_AshurMagi7: Ashur declared her ambition to study magic diligently and create a future where everyone can be happy. Suddenly fired up, she excused herself to conduct research and hurried into a room in the corner of Ashur's Heart. I decided to support her dream from beside her.
LoveHero_AshurMagi: So you are interested in magic too, Master! I will teach you carefully, starting from the fundamentals!
LoveHeroCancel_AshurMagi: H-Huh? Master? Where are you going?! I have not finished explaining magical theory yet!
Food_ChefNote_AshurMagi_Hate1: She coldly dismissed it as a lazy dish that took the easy route, preparing an unusual ingredient like melon in a bland and uninspired way.
Food_ChefNote_AshurMagi_Hate2: The moment Ashur saw the garnet fruit, she recoiled and pushed the plate away. Apparently, she once suffered through someone's particularly nasty prank involving it.
Food_ChefNote_AshurMagi_Like1: She praised it as a convenient light meal for those times when she is too busy researching even to cook.
Food_ChefNote_AshurMagi_Like10: After examining the sparkling powder with fascination, she slowly tried one bite. She immediately praised its magical flavor and devoured the rest in an instant.
Food_ChefNote_AshurMagi_Like2: Ashur happily said that while the caramel was good, the crisp texture of freshly popped popcorn was the true attraction.
Food_ChefNote_AshurMagi_Like3: She marveled at its endlessly satisfying chewiness and kept munching while saying it might inspire her next magical bread.
Food_ChefNote_AshurMagi_Like4: After chewing one bite, she asked for paper and a pen. She became completely absorbed in savoring it and deducing the recipe.
Food_ChefNote_AshurMagi_Like5: Ashur tossed the powder into her mouth in one go. Before long, she was busily squirming all over. The sourness must have been intense.
Food_ChefNote_AshurMagi_Like6: After eating one, Ashur called its flavor magical. Though they all looked alike, she explained, each one revealed a different taste.
Food_ChefNote_AshurMagi_Like7: She delighted in the gentle sweetness, saying it would make a perfect palate cleanser after feeding Erpin magical bread.
Food_ChefNote_AshurMagi_Like8: She praised it as food that made her feel stronger with every bite. Once she finished, she rushed out of the banquet hall, overflowing with the urge to research.
Food_ChefNote_AshurMagi_Like9: Although she made it herself, she proudly declared that it had turned out exceptionally well. Whenever she needs sugar, she says she rummages through the container wondering which flavor she will get.

AshurMagi_Affinity2: Would you like to see me conjure fire from my hands? What do you think? I look more like a proper mage now, right?

AshurMagi_Affinity7: How long will I keep researching? Well... until I am satisfied, perhaps? Hehe, you will support me too, Master, right?

LoveLetter_AshurMagi:
Master! I failed to make the greatest magical bread again today! Ahahaha...!
But it does not feel as painful as it used to. Is it because you often visit Ashur's Heart to encourage me?
In any case, thanks to you, my determination to keep trying is overflowing!
I will keep working hard until the day I create the greatest magical bread that satisfies everyone, so you have to keep watching over me~ Hehehe...!!!
LoveCall_AshurMagi:
Master~! Are you busy right now?
If you are free, I would like you to come to Ashur's Heart!
Why? Hmm... For some reason, I seem to focus better whenever you watch me conduct my research, Master. Hehe...

You remember, right? That night the two of us stayed up together!
We shared bread and chatted away... Puhuhuhu!
Why am I laughing by myself? I just... feel happy remembering it. We had fun, did we not?

Maybe that is why I keep wanting to call you over and have you sit beside me lately... It really keeps happening.
I have even thought about moving my research desk into a corner of your room. Then I could focus every moment! Hehe.
Ah~ Hearing your voice makes me want to research magic even more!
I cannot wait! I am grabbing my magic notebook and running to the Order right now!
Hehehe. See you soon~!!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP01_002: What are you saying? Surely... that is not a magic incantation?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP01_003: Of course it is. Are you pretending not to know, or do you truly have no idea...?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP01_004: Oh~ That spell sounds like the name of delicious bread.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP01_005: Right? I created it myself, and I am very fond of it!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP01_006: W-What?! You are not trying to blow up the banquet hall with magic, are you?!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP01_007: Of course not! What kind of person do you usually imagine I am?!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP02_001: Sometimes, your words of encouragement truly reach my heart, Master.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP02_002: Keep it up~ You can do it~ Go, go~!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP02_003: Ugh... I did not mean that sort of indiscriminate cheering!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP02_004: Then I will encourage you more often.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP02_005: You mean it? Hehe. I would like that!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP02_006: Perhaps they reach you because you have worked so hard.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP02_007: Yes... I truly have been working hard... Thank you for recognizing it...!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP03_001: What would make a good motivational trigger for my research?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP03_002: A photograph of Erpin looking happy?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP03_003: Ah... I like that. I truly look forward to the day Her Majesty eats my magical bread and smiles with happiness.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP03_004: A picture of your future self as the ultimate Archmage?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP03_005: Hahaha! Merely imagining it feels wonderful!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP03_006: Did you not say that outfit was your trigger? Do you need another?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP03_007: The more triggers I have, the better they motivate me!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP04_001: I recently found something resembling a straw at the Order, and it startled me terribly...
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP04_002: Really? Do straws bring back unpleasant memories?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP04_003: I... cannot discuss it... and I never want to see one again.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP04_004: A single straw frightened you? Hehe, you are rather timid.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP04_005: It was not merely an ordinary straw! You know nothing about it!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP04_006: Here, wipe away the cold sweat with this handkerchief. It must have truly terrified you.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP04_007: Thank you... May I rest here until I calm down?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP05_002: Is your magic research going badly? Is it tormenting you? I will teach it a lesson!!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP05_004: Pushing yourself is one way to grow.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP05_005: Exactly. I will never lose sight of the determination with which I began!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP05_006: First, drink some cold water, then tell me what happened.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP05_007: Whew... That is not enough. Could you float some ice in it too?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP06_001: Have you ever listened to a playlist designed to improve concentration?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP06_002: I heard only people with poor concentration listen to those.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP06_003: ...That is a baseless rumor. Who told you that?!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP06_004: Nobody. Why do you listen to one?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP06_005: As its name suggests, you listen when you want to concentrate better. Are you interested?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP06_006: No, I want to hear it right now! Play it for me!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP06_007: Hehe. I will play it immediately. Let us share a period of concentration together.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP07_001: Do you know what it feels like to be shocked with electricity, Master?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP07_002: I do not even want to imagine it. Ugh...
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP07_004: It sounds incredibly painful... There are no lasting effects, are there?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP07_005: Fortunately, no. Once you lose consciousness, the pain disappears too.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP07_006: At least it probably does not tickle.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP07_007: It can feel a little ticklish afterward. A prickling itch at one's fingertips, perhaps?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP08_002: Did a magical formula suddenly occur to you?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP08_003: Yes! Eating this dish inspired an excellent formula!! Haha!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP08_004: Why are you groaning? Does something hurt?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP08_005: That sound escapes me without my noticing whenever an excellent formula occurs to me.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP08_007: Ahh... Your sense of humor, Master...
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP09_001: Could you give me everything from here to here?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP09_003: Eating plenty helps me concentrate! Hmph!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP09_004: Gasp. Then I would spend the entire day cooking. Do you truly want me to make it all?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP09_005: Yes! I have always wanted to spend an entire day eating your cooking, Master!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP09_007: You cannot know until you try! Do not give up, Master!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP10_001: Whenever you need the power of an Archmage, come to me!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP10_002: Really? Then could you clean the banquet hall with magic?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP10_003: Hmm... To think I would become a cleaning maid...
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP10_004: Is it acceptable to use such advanced magic so casually?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP10_005: I am using it to help you, Master~
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP10_006: You are not an Archmage yet, are you?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP10_007: ...I will be in the future! Stop picking apart every little thing!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP11_001: Patra may act curt, but she helps me a great deal whenever things are difficult. ...I should thank her properly sometime soon.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP11_002: I thought her constant mint bread caused you trouble.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP11_003: Well... that is true. Still, she has also worked hard for me in many ways.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP11_004: That is a fine idea! Patra will be delighted.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP11_005: H-Hmm. Do you think so? I worried it might seem too sudden... I hope she is as pleased as you say, Master!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP11_006: Mere words may seem insincere. Give her a gift as well.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP11_007: A gift? Hmm... That sounds promising. Please accompany me to choose one next time!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP12_001: Ugh...! My research has been going nowhere lately. What am I missing?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP12_002: Why not stop rushing and rest for a while?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP12_003: Hmm... You are right. Whether in research or anything else, maintaining my own pace matters. Thank you! You have helped me calm down, Master.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP12_004: At times like this, it is best to begin again from the fundamentals.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP12_005: I have reviewed the fundamental theory countless times... but you are right. I should reconsider the very objective and foundation of my research!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP12_006: Instead of worrying here, hurry back to your research!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP12_007: D-Do not push me, Master! Surely I can at least satisfy my hunger before researching!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP13_003: Physical force...? Gasp! Of course. If I substitute equations based on physical laws back into the spells I treated as exceptions...! Thank you, Master! I believe I have realized something!!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP13_004: When mana particles combine with Eldir molecules and Muclis particles...
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP13_005: M-Master, how do you know such terminology?! Have you been secretly studying magical theory?!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP13_007: Ugh, Master! Magic is impressive and spectacular, but that is not the question troubling me!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP14_001: Sometimes, researching a new bread recipe also aids my magical research.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP14_002: Really? Perhaps operating the bakery alongside it is not such a bad idea.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP14_003: W-Well... that is true. But its essential nature as a magic school will never change!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP14_004: That merely sounds like an excuse to operate a bakery.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP14_005: N-No! It truly helps! If I apply the principles of balancing dough ratios to adjusting mana concentration...!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP14_006: Every field contains something from which one can draw inspiration.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP14_007: Exactly! I have begun seeing things I overlooked when I focused exclusively on magic! I knew you would understand, Master!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP15_002: She looks exhausted. Let us leave her asleep.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP15_003: Mmph... Hmm... Your Majesty... Please try... the new bread I developed...
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP15_005: W-Waah! You startled me! M-Master! You frightened me!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP15_006: Ashur, go home and sleep if you are tired.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP15_007: Huh...? Ah, I-I'm sorry! I fell asleep without realizing it. Ugh... How embarrassing...
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP16_001: Some prototype magical breads have accumulated in the storehouse. I will share them with you, Master!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP16_002: Garbage belongs in the garbage bin!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP16_003: G-Garbage?! Every one of those breads possesses its own value!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP16_004: Well, if it helps your research... I will try a few.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP16_005: Wow! Thank you! Which will you try first? The Mana-Rampage Ciabatta?! The Luminescent Baguette?! The Giant Bagel?!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP16_006: They truly are safe to eat, correct?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP16_007: Of course! There may be tiiiny side effects, but if you eat only those I labeled edible, there should be no major problem!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP17_001: Am I becoming too obsessed with research? Yesterday, I even conducted magical research in my dreams.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP17_002: Oh? More time for research. That sounds excellent!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP17_003: You do not think of me as a research machine, do you?! This is where you are supposed to pity me!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP17_004: I will brew you a tea that relieves fatigue.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP17_005: Th-Thank you, Master...! As I thought, the time I spend with you... is my only time to rest!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP17_006: Did you dream of becoming an Archmage?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP17_007: H-How did you know?! Did you peek into my dream with that ghost?!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP18_001: Wearing new clothes has certainly changed my state of mind.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP18_002: There is nothing wrong with looking splendid, but do not become vain!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP18_003: What?! Th-They are not that extravagant! Honestly... Would it hurt simply to compliment me?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP18_005: H-Huh? I-I have not thought about my next outfit yet. ...What would you like to see me wear, Master?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP18_006: Everyone needs such a change of pace. It suits you well too.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP18_007: R-Really? It suits me? Hehe... Thank you, Master. Thanks to you, my resolve feels even firmer!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP19_001: If I work hard enough... someday, changing the future will become possible too, will it not?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP19_002: Perhaps... It depends upon what you do.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP19_003: ...You are right. It depends upon me. Thank you, Master. I feel encouraged!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP19_004: Should you not focus upon the present rather than some grand future?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP19_005: B-But... I cannot remain content with the present! Someday, I will seize a bright future with my own hands!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP19_006: Yes. It may be difficult now, but I know you can do it, Ashur!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP19_007: Master...! Thank you. Even if nobody else understands my work... I can work even harder as long as you support me!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP20_001: How would you feel if you met a Master from another world who looked exactly like you?
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP20_002: That sounds entertaining! I would go out and have fun with them!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP20_003: H-Hmm... The sight of you playing with another you... might be somewhat bewildering...
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP20_004: It would be confusing at first, but I think I would speak with them.
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP20_005: Speak with them... You are thoughtful as ever, Master. Thank you. You have helped me organize my thoughts!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP20_006: I would defeat them and become the one and only me!
Affinity_AshurMagi_EP20_007: D-Defeat them?! Master... You are more ambitious than I realized...
